notes.title: Taiko 5 updated to 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Taiko 5 has been updated to version 1.0.3 (PC). This build includes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when using the Right Stick to edit all effects parameters (Left Stick is pushed to the edge on an effect) so that it moves up/down properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where buttons would disappear when pressing the X/West button if the Pattern View is visible.
[*] Added 4 more background images.
[/list]

Thanks,

Larry

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Added dedicated Randomizer button
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Just a heads up that the face buttons have been slightly tweaked to allow for a dedicated Randomization button. This button will randomize the percussion, music, and effects (in a more subtle way). It can still focus on favorited kits as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/21a0fbb15b81d6dc1a40bc905a55c1085d9496ac.png[/img]

Thanks,

Larry

notes.title: Taiko 5 updated to version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Taiko 5 has been updated to version 1.0. This milestone update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Added more musical type sounds, bringing the built-in sound count to over 1,000!
[*] Fixed issues with the left stick not being responsive when initially opening the app.
[*] Fixed the Sound Edit and Settings screens being open at the same time.
[*] Fixed the Sound Edit Volume setting not saving properly.
[*] Updated some of the graphics.
[*] Fixed some tempo sync issues.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/ae8a64e670ba0b0320b95e002ff4b2b5f8ca5f7e.png[/img]

The release date has been set as June 28 as well! Exciting times!

Thanks,

Larry

notes.title: v0.9.90 - New Sounds Added
notes.notes:
Hello there,

I'm happy to share that 420 percussion sounds have been added to Taiko 5. These sounds are acoustic style drum sounds from contributors. A huge thanks goes to George Rennie!

With these new sounds there are now 35 full percussion style kits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/738af0abc54bd29b18ffa28d20cbe1db688fbf02.png[/img]

More updates and sounds to come!

All the best,

Larry

notes.title: Updates for v0.9.86
notes.notes:
Hello there,

I'd just like to share that the randomization functionality in Taiko 5 (especially for the demo) has been updated and fixed. It's now possible to randomize just the percussion, music, or both in a more simplified way. 

Also, the parameter/effects randomization functionality has been separated into its own Settings parameter. This new parameter controls the intensity of the parameter/effects randomization where higher values means more extreme effects settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/c86d5f4495d11d43da340e6fccb5596cfc8cd880.png[/img]

More to come!

Thanks,

Larry
